```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)

check_data <- function(data) {
  cat("### Data Structure\n")
  str(data)

  cat("\n### Missing Values per Column\n")
  missing_df <- data %>%
    summarise_all(~sum(is.na(.))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Column", values_to = "Missing_Values") %>%
    arrange(desc(Missing_Values))

  print(knitr::kable(missing_df))

  cat("\n### Total Duplicate Rows\n")
  duplicates <- sum(duplicated(data))
  cat(paste0(duplicates, "\n"))
}

check_factor_levels <- function(data) {
  for (colname in names(data)) {
    if (is.factor(data[[colname]])) {
      cat(paste0("Levels for '", colname, "':\n"))
      print(levels(data[[colname]]))
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
}

```

# country_results_df analysis



## Original Data

```{r}
check_data(country_results)
```

## Country_results: Factor data and analysis

```{r}

country_results_cleaned <- country_results %>%
  mutate(
    country = as.factor(country),
    year = as.factor(year),
    awards_gold = as.factor(awards_gold),
    awards_silver = as.factor(awards_silver),
    awards_bronze = as.factor(awards_bronze),
    awards_honorable_mentions = as.factor(awards_honorable_mentions),
    p1 = as.factor(p1),
    p2 = as.factor(p2),
    p3 = as.factor(p3),
    p4 = as.factor(p4),
    p5 = as.factor(p5),
    p6 = as.factor(p6),
    p7 = as.factor(p7),
  )

check_factor_levels(country_results_cleaned)
summary(country_results_cleaned)

```


### Check if results tally

```{r}
discrepancy_check <- individual_results %>%
  mutate(sum_p = as.integer(p1) + as.integer(p2) + as.integer(p3) +
                 as.integer(p4) + as.integer(p5) + as.integer(p6)+ as.integer(p7),
         difference = as.integer(total) - sum_p) %>%
  filter(difference != 0)

# Show rows with discrepancy (All the totals add up if we use p7)
print(discrepancy_check %>% 
        select(year, contestant, country, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6,p7, total, sum_p, difference))
```

### Checking for mismatch

```{r}
# Check for mismatches
inconsistent_rows <- timeline %>%
  filter((male_contestant + female_contestant) != all_contestant)

# Display number of inconsistent entries
n_inconsistent <- nrow(inconsistent_rows)
cat("Number of inconsistent rows:", n_inconsistent, "\n")

# Optionally: View the actual inconsistent rows
# print(inconsistent_rows)

# Add a column showing the discrepancy
discrepancy_check <- timeline %>%
  mutate(sum_mf = male_contestant + female_contestant,
         difference = all_contestant - sum_mf) %>%
  filter(difference != 0)

# Show the rows with mismatch and the difference
print(discrepancy_check %>% select(year, country, male_contestant, female_contestant, all_contestant, sum_mf, difference))

```

```{r}
check_factor_levels(timeline_cleaned)
```
